name: Athena
oneLine: One MCP gateway that gives AI assistants a single tool surface over ten self-hosted services.
problem: Each self-hosted service has its own interface, so an AI assistant needs a separate integration for every one of them.
built: An MCP server with one adapter per service: Firefly III, Homebox, Paperless-ngx, Immich, Blinko, TickTick, Tavily, Uptime Kuma, Beszel and weather. Clients documented in the project are Claude Desktop, VS Code with GitHub Copilot, and n8n workflows; any MCP client can connect.
decisions: One gateway instead of one integration per client.
Each service sits behind its own adapter, so adding a service does not touch the others.
